notes.title: Introducing: Heir of the Dog
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934633/0c32cfb898bab1feaeed0cd6ec1be1ca5d5a424d.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558970/Hair_of_the_Dog/]Hair of the Dog[/url] was a short adventure game I created for AdvXJam back in 2020. It was created in twelve days, so was a little rough around the edges, but pipped [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/]Lucy Dreaming[/url] to the post as the first game I ever released on Steam. In that respect it was a great test-run, paving the way for Lucy two years later.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558970/Hair_of_the_Dog/]Hair of the Dog[/url] has enjoyed over 25,000 downloads on various platforms since it was released, and I have received hundreds of messages and reviews from people all over the world requesting a full length version.

[h1]Well, here it is![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/]Heir of the Dog[/url] will return to the fog-covered streets of Victorian London to expand on the life of Cummerbund Bandersnatch and his curious condition.

[previewyoutube=Sf4RvyPpPMg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Demo coming soon![/h2]
The demo is tantalisingly almost finished, with the voices being recorded as I type, but that shouldn't stop anyone from adding it to their wishlist (we all know how the Steam algorithm loves a wishlist!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934633/3a0c17fafb7afdf40f6b42adc88852e3318debf7.png[/img]

The demo is predominantly a recreation of the original Game Jam game from 2020 so, if you've played it before, the majority of the puzzles and dialogue will be familiar to you, but I have applied everything I learned whilst developing Lucy Dreaming in terms of the improved UI, controller support and artwork. So, even if you have met Cummerbund before, why not clear the fog with a stroll down Memory Lane when the demo is released. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934633/2845656f71e433240579717ebd4124303336bea4.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/][h2]Add it to your wishlist now[/h2][/url]
